versions.changelog:
- Initial release of tutur-humanizer skill.
- Rewrite, edit, or review Indonesian text to sound natural, human, and context-appropriate.
- Supports register adaptation for formal, professional, casual/slang, sales, and academic/technical Indonesian upon request.

- Reference materials and examples provided for consistent skill application.
